title: Committee of Supply − Head O (Ministry of Health)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply − Head O (Ministry of Health)

sections.label: Healthcare budget and spending
sections.summary: Healthcare spending is a small share of GDP but the 2017 budget is close to S$10.7 billion, about an eighth of the operating Budget and almost 10% higher than last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: True, healthcare expenditure remains a small percentage of our gross domestic product (GDP) compared to what many other developed countries spend.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: But I note that, this year, the healthcare budget is close to S$10.7 billion, which is about an eighth of our operating Budget for 2017, and this is almost a 10% increase from last year's Budget.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Just a few years ago, then Finance Minister Deputy Prime Minister Tharman announced that we can expect healthcare spending to jump to $12 billion by 2020, and it certainly seems that we may be reaching this target earlier rather than later.

sections.label: Rationalise not ration healthcare
sections.summary: The speaker says healthcare should be rationalised, not rationed, and notes MOH's three shifts: beyond hospital to community, quality to value, healthcare to health.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: My point is that we should rationalise, but not ration.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I was encouraged that MOH had earlier announced three key shifts in healthcare (a) moving beyond the hospital to the community; (b) beyond quality to value; and (c) beyond healthcare to health.

sections.label: Smoking, diet and NurtureSG
sections.summary: Smoking prevalence, healthy eating, exercise and work-life balance remain struggles, and the speaker applauds the NurtureSG programme's announcement.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Smoking prevalence continues to be stubbornly sticky, many of us still feel helpless when trying to eat healthily and exercise often, and trying to maintain an optimal work-life balance remains a struggle for many.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I applaud the recent announcement of the NurtureSG programme, which encapsulates many suggestions that healthcare professionals have been advocating.

sections.label: ElderShield payout and financing care
sections.summary: The 3M framework does not adequately address this care area, and the GPC for Health recommends revising the insufficient ElderShield payout and will present suggestions to the ElderShield Review Committee.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, there remain concerns about how such care will be financed as the current MediSave, MediShield Life and MediFund (3M) framework does not adequately address this area of care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: In our 2013 Paper on Healthcare Affordability, we opined that "with the integration of social care and healthcare under one Ministry, the Government Parliamentary Committee (GPC) for Health recommends that the current ElderShield payout be revised.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Meant for severely disabled elderly Singaporeans, the current ElderShield payout is insufficient for Singaporeans to even cover nursing home fees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Its coverage should, therefore, be strengthened to make it more relevant." The GPC for Health has been concerned about this issue for some time now, and we will be presenting our comments and suggestions to the ElderShield Review Committee in due course.

sections.label: PHMCA review and patient welfare
sections.summary: The speaker repeats that healthcare should be rationalised not rationed, and asks about the progress of MOH's review of the Private Hospitals and Medical Clinics Act and how it will safeguard patients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I think it bears repeating that we should rationalise and not ration healthcare.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: It has also announced that MOH is reviewing the Private Hospitals and Medical Clinics Act (PHMCA).

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: What is the progress of this review and how will updating this Act better safeguard the welfare of our patients?

sections.label: Nursing home beds and manpower
sections.summary: Singapore had about 26.1 nursing home beds per 1,000 people aged 65 and above in 2015, the lowest in 15 years, with plans for over 17,000 beds and 30,000 healthcare workers by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The report found that "Singapore had around 26.1 nursing home beds per 1,000 people aged 65 and above in 2015 − the lowest proportion in 15 years − down from around 28 beds in 2000 and well below the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development average of 45.2 beds." The Straits Times article goes on to add that based on the percentage of the elderly population living in residential aged care facilities in developed countries, such as the US, Australia and Finland, there will be 50,000 seniors in Singapore who will require such facilities by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Government's current plan is to bring the total number of nursing home beds to slightly over 17,000 by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: On manpower, the Government's Healthcare Manpower Plan 2020 seeks to add 30,000 healthcare workers by 2020.

sections.label: Nurse and doctor graduate numbers
sections.summary: The passage asks how confident MOH is in meeting Manpower Plan 2020 targets given falling nurse, allied health and medical graduates, and asks about foreign-to-local nurse ratios.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Given that the number of nurses and allied health professional graduates has fallen since 2012, while the number of medical graduates has also fallen since 2013, all these despite great efforts by the Government to make these jobs more attractive, how confident is MOH in meeting the targets in the Manpower Plan 2020?

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It was reported that there were 2,100 foreign doctors in public hospitals and polyclinics at the end of 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Also, what is the ratio of foreign nurses to local nurses currently in public hospitals and polyclinics, and what is the ratio that the Ministry hopes to achieve by 2020?

sections.label: Drug prices and transparency
sections.summary: The passage notes some Singaporeans find medicine costly, cites 2012 profit margins of 5% to 30%, and repeats a call to publish public hospital drug prices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang
sentences.text: Based on feedback from residents, some Singaporeans still find the cost of medicine high.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang
sentences.text: The Minister said in 2012 that the profit margins for drugs sold in public hospitals typically range from 5% to 30%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang
sentences.text: The Minister rejected this saying that, "drugs constitute only one aspect of the overall treatment." I would like to repeat the call to publish drug prices at public hospitals for better transparency.

sections.label: Pneumococcal vaccination subsidies
sections.summary: The passage states WP called for fully subsidised pneumococcal vaccinations in 2013 and 2015, the Minister said this was not necessary, and a full vaccine series costs around $500.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang
sentences.text: In 2013 and, again in 2015, when WP called for fully subsidised pneumococcal vaccinations, the Minister said that this was not necessary since "the potential for a public health epidemic or outbreak is relatively low." Madam, a complete series of the vaccine doses costs around $500, which is costly for parents.

sections.label: Subsidy drop at higher income tier
sections.summary: The passage states that if per capita monthly household income rises to between $701 and $1,100, subsidies will drop to 60%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Subsequently, if the per capita monthly household income rises to the next tier, that is, between $701 to $1,100, due to salary increment, bonus or commission, the subsidies will drop to 60%.

sections.label: Medical bill and CPF balance
sections.summary: The passage states a medical bill had $120 outstanding in cash after MediSave deduction, and a 91-year-old parent's CPF statement showed more than $10,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: On the medical bill, it was stated $120 outstanding for payment in cash, after deducting MediSave claim.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Then, she showed me the CPF statement of her 91-year-old parent.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: There was more than $10,000 in her CPF.

sections.label: Outpatient MediSave for seniors
sections.summary: The passage states patients aged 65 and above can deduct up to $200 yearly for outpatient treatment at listed institutions, usable with other MediSave limits like MediSave400.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Under this scheme, all patients aged 65 and above can deduct up to $200 per year per patient for outpatient medical treatment at Specialist Outpatient Clinics at the public hospitals or the national specialty centres, polyclinics and Participating Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) general practitioner (GP) clinics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: It can also be used together with other outpatient MediSave limits, such as the MediSave400 limit.

sections.label: MediShield Life community hospital claims
sections.summary: MediShield Life benefits for inpatient treatment at community hospitals are claimable only upon referral from a public hospital after an inpatient admission.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Based on the current MediShield Life system, MediShield Life benefits for inpatient treatment at community hospitals are only claimable upon referral from a public hospital for further medical treatment after an inpatient admission.

sections.label: Payout inadequacy over time
sections.summary: Fifteen years later, the same payout makes its inadequacy even more severe.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Fifteen years later, the same payout makes its inadequacy even more severe.

sections.label: ElderShield permanent and universal
sections.summary: ElderShield should be made permanent while disability persists and converted from opt-out to a universal scheme covering everyone.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: ElderShield has to be made permanent as long as the disability persists, if this scheme is to serve as a safety net and a remaining piece towards strengthening our society, as the Prime Minister referred to.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: The present opt-out scheme of ElderShield should be converted into a universal scheme to cover everyone and ensure that no one is left out.

sections.label: ElderShield claimants in 15 years
sections.summary: In the 15 years since it started, there have been about 13,000 claimants.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: In the 15 years since it started, there have been about 13,000 claimants.

sections.label: ElderShield premiums for ages 60 to 64
sections.summary: For those aged 60 to 64, the annual premium to join ElderShield is from $1,000 to $3,000 respectively.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: For those aged 60 to 64, the annual premium payable to join ElderShield is from $1,000 to $3,000 respectively.

sections.label: Review ART treatment co-funding
sections.summary: Four years after the Government enhanced co-funding of ART treatments, it should be time to review this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: This is important but we should also provide more help for those who want to start a family but are facing difficulties conceiving.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: It has been four years since the Government enhanced the co-funding of ART treatments, and it should be time for us to review this.

sections.label: Diabetes cost estimate Singapore
sections.summary: The NUS School of Public Health estimates diabetes could cost Singapore $2.5 billion a year by 2050, plus human suffering.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The National University of Singapore (NUS) School of Public Health estimates that diabetes could cause Singapore $2.5 billion a year by 2050, not to mention the cost of human suffering.

sections.label: Food processing ITM and diabetes
sections.summary: The food processing ITM is advanced and well-placed to promote low-sugar products, as diabetic numbers and complications are projected to rise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Industry Transformation Map (ITM) for food processing is more advanced than most other ITMs and seems well-placed to develop and promote low-sugar products on an industry basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: It is projected that in less than 20 years, the number of diabetics in Singapore could rise to 670,000 and more than a million Singaporeans could get diabetes by 2050.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: In numbers, every two days, nine people lose their kidneys because of diabetes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Furthermore, every day, four amputations are carried out because of complications from diabetes.

sections.label: Smart cluster housing for seniors
sections.summary: The passage asks whether MOH will consider smart cluster housing where seniors live in converted HDB rental flats, studio apartments or new HDB homes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: Will MOH consider a concept of "smart cluster housing" where many seniors live in the same block of flats on their own, in their 1- or 2-room flats, which can be converted from the Housing and Development Board (HDB) rental flats, some studio apartments or even newly-built HDB homes?

sections.label: Women's ill-health years
sections.summary: The Global Burden of Disease 2015 reports women spend the last nine years of life in ill-health, with life expectancy 84.9 for women and 80.4 for men.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: According to the Global Burden of Disease 2015 published in the Lancet last year, women spend the last nine years of their lives in ill-health.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: In 2015, life expectancy for women here was 84.9 years and, for men, 80.4 years, making people here among the longest living in the world.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: But women spend 10.7% of their lives in ill-health, and men 9.4%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: In fact, men here top the world in terms of the number of healthy years they live, according to the Lancet report.

sections.label: Enabling Masterplan 3 recommendations
sections.summary: The Enabling Masterplan 3 was issued in December last year with recommendations and strategies for a more inclusive society and better caregiver support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Since then, the Enabling Masterplan 3 was issued in December last year, with various recommendations and proposed strategies to create a more inclusive society for people with disabilities as well as to provide better support to caregivers in their roles in caring for persons with disabilities.

sections.label: Caregivers' poor mental health
sections.summary: The speaker notes concern that a 2014 NCSS study found a good number of caregivers experienced poor mental health.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: In this regard, I am concerned to note that the National Council of Social Service (NCSS) study in 2014 found that a good number of our caregivers experienced poor mental health.

sections.label: Limited disability programme spaces
sections.summary: Drop-in Disability Programmes and Day Activity Centres have limited spaces, and applicants are often waitlisted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: While there are options of Drop-in Disability Programmes and Day Activity Centres, as acknowledged in this House by Minister Tan Chuan-Jin, there are limited spaces in such programmes and applicants are often waitlisted.

sections.label: Foreign Domestic Worker Levy Concession
sections.summary: Enabling Masterplan 3 identifies expanding Foreign Domestic Worker Levy Concession and Grant criteria, and it is recommended this be extended to mental disabilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: One area identified in Enabling Masterplan 3 to enhance caregivers' well-being and their caregiving capabilities, albeit with respect to persons having physical disabilities, is the possibility of expanding the existing criteria for Foreign Domestic Worker Levy Concession and Grant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: I also recommend that the Foreign Domestic Worker Levy Concession and Grant be extended to families with persons having mental disabilities, too.

sections.label: Ageing and caregiver support centre
sections.summary: The issue will deepen with the rapidly ageing population, and a Disability Caregiver Support Centre will be set up.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: This issue will deepen with the rapidly ageing population.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: I note that the Government will be setting up a Disability Caregiver Support Centre.

sections.label: Medicalised nursing home care model
sections.summary: Despite new nursing homes being ramped up, the care model in nursing homes remains the medicalised model similar to hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: Even as we are ramping up new nursing homes, sadly, the care model in our nursing homes remains the so-called "medicalised model" similar to hospitals.

sections.label: Moving to rehabilitative care model
sections.summary: The US, Japan and Australia have moved away from the medicalised model, and MOH set up the Enhanced Nursing Home Standard in 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: Countries like the US, Japan and Australia have moved away from the "medicalised" model.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: We should move away from the "medicalised" model now and aim for the rehabilitative model, making the living environment more like homes and less like hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: MOH set up the Enhanced Nursing Home Standard in 2014 providing basic standards for medical and nursing care, facilities maintenance and hygiene.

sections.label: Varying nursing home standards
sections.summary: The standards of nursing homes in Singapore vary considerably.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: The standards of nursing homes in Singapore do vary considerably.

sections.label: Eldercare model shift
sections.summary: Land scarcity, manpower constraints and a vision of ageing in place mean the eldercare model must shift away from institutions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: With land scarcity and manpower constraints and our vision towards ageing in place, the eldercare model needs to shift away from institutions.

sections.label: Diabetes and obesity rates
sections.summary: Premature mortality rates for both diseases were halved between 2000 and 2015, but obesity among younger Singaporeans doubled and one in three Singaporeans is projected to develop diabetes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Between 2000 and 2015, we have reduced the premature mortality rates for both diseases by half.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: What is even more worrying is that the obesity rate amongst younger Singaporeans aged 18 to 39 has grown at an even faster rate, doubling from 4.2% to 8.4% over the same period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Based on our projections, one in three Singaporeans will develop diabetes in their lifetime.

sections.label: Hospital bed expansion
sections.summary: Together with expanding existing facilities, a total of 2,500 hospital beds were added.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Together with the expansion of existing facilities, we have added a total of 2,500 hospital beds.

sections.label: MediShield Life claims 2016
sections.summary: Over 500,000 claims were approved under MediShield Life in 2016, a 47% increase over 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Over 500,000 claims were approved under MediShield Life in 2016, an increase of 47% compared to 2015.

sections.label: MediShield Life coverage purpose
sections.summary: MediShield Life was designed primarily to provide coverage for large, acute hospital bills.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: MediShield Life was designed primarily to provide coverage for large, acute hospital bills.

sections.label: Flexi-MediSave scheme introduction
sections.summary: The Flexi-MediSave scheme was introduced in 2015 to let older Singaporeans use up to $200 a year for outpatient medical treatment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: The Flexi-MediSave scheme was recently introduced in 2015 to allow older Singaporeans to use up to $200 a year to pay for outpatient medical treatment.

sections.label: Healthcare funding and drug subsidies
sections.summary: The government provided $4.3 billion to public healthcare institutions, and SOCs and polyclinics give up to 75% subsidies for standard drugs, with Pioneers getting 50% more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In fact, last year, we provided a total of $4.3 billion of funding to our public healthcare institutions to support their operations to keep our healthcare costs low.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: To help patients with their medication costs, our public healthcare institutions like our Specialist Outpatient Clinics (SOCs) and our polyclinics provide subsidies of up to 75% for standard drugs, with Pioneers receiving a further 50% subsidy.

sections.label: Reorganising healthcare into three clusters
sections.summary: In January, it was announced that the healthcare system will be reorganised into three integrated clusters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In January, we announced that we will be reorganising our healthcare system into three integrated clusters.

sections.label: Agency for Care Effectiveness guidance
sections.summary: ACE was set up to evaluate clinical and cost-effectiveness of new treatments and will publish its first Guidance in May this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: The Agency for Care Effectiveness (ACE) was set up to evaluate the clinical and cost-effectiveness of new treatments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: ACE will be publishing their first set of Guidance in May this year.

sections.label: National Diabetes Taskforce focus areas
sections.summary: The National Diabetes Prevention and Care Taskforce was set up with three strategic focus areas: healthy living and prevention, screening and follow-up, and disease management.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: The National Diabetes Prevention and Care Taskforce was set up to drive the efforts on this war with three strategic focus areas, namely, healthy living and prevention; screening and follow-up; and disease management.

sections.label: Community Health Posts and CNS expansion
sections.summary: Community Health Posts under CNS make health screening and monitoring accessible; about 30 active ageing nodes engaged over 5,000 seniors, with CNS expansion planned by end-2017 in Tampines, Marine Parade and Chua Chu Kang GRCs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We set up Community Health Posts under CNS to make services, such as health screening and monitoring, more accessible to residents living in our heartlands.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We have already established some 30 active ageing nodes in the three pilot CNS sites and engaged over 5,000 seniors, including those with diabetes or at risk of diabetes, in preventive health activities, such as health screening and monitoring, health talks and exercise sessions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We plan to expand CNS to the remaining precincts in the three participating Group Representation Constituencies (GRCs) of Tampines, Marine Parade and Chua Chu Kang by the end of 2017.

sections.label: Mdm Goh's diabetes prevention
sections.summary: Mdm Goh Soo Eng, at risk of diabetes, joined HPB's Diabetes Prevention Programme, kept her blood sugar under control without medication, and now advocates healthy living.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: One of the beneficiaries is Mdm Goh Soo Eng who was at risk of diabetes due to her elevated blood sugar level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Under the recommendation of her doctor, Mdm Goh joined HPB's Diabetes Prevention Programme and learnt to adopt healthy eating and exercise habits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Through these efforts, Mdm Goh has managed to keep her blood sugar level under control without the need for medication and is now an advocate for healthy living and diabetes prevention.

sections.label: HealthHub Track app launch
sections.summary: HPB will launch HealthHub Track in April, a personal health management app with digital tools to monitor and manage health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We hope to see many more take a step towards proactive disease management and prevent diabetes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Therefore, HPB will launch the "HealthHub Track" in April this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: This is a personal health management app in HealthHub which will provide users with digital tools to monitor and manage their health conditions more conveniently.

sections.label: MacPherson mental health programmes
sections.summary: In MacPherson, VWOs and agencies including AIC and South East CDC support programmes such as the MacPherson Mental Health Programme and Dementia Friendly Community.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: In MacPherson, we are thankful to have the support of VWOs and agencies, such as the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) and South East Community Development Council (CDC), to implement a range of programmes, including the MacPherson Mental Health Programme and Dementia Friendly Community.

sections.label: Database of elderly with dementia
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry would consider creating a database of elderly diagnosed with dementia so the community can support them better.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: This will help these elderly continue to be part of our community and lead lives as normal as possible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Hence, would the Ministry consider creating a database of elderly diagnosed with dementia so that the community can support these elderly better?

sections.label: Police referrals to AIC counsellors
sections.summary: Police officers contacted should be aware of referring such cases to AIC for help and assessment, and over 120 GPs are trained in mild to moderate mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: And in the event that the Police are contacted, officers should also be aware of the need to refer such cases to AIC for help and assessment from its professional counsellors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I understand that, to date, we have over 120 GPs trained in the diagnosis and support of patients with mild to moderate mental health conditions.

sections.label: Projections of dementia numbers
sections.summary: Alzheimer's Disease Association projections say 187,000 people aged 65 and above will have dementia by 2050, and Assoc Prof Nagaendran Kandiah estimated 10% of 40,000 people with dementia are below 65.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: Based on projections from the Alzheimer's Disease Association, by 2050, we will be faced with 187,000 people aged 65 and above who have dementia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: In an article last year, Assoc Prof Nagaendran Kandiah at the National Neuroscience Institute (NNI) estimated that of the 40,000 people with dementia in Singapore, 10% are below the age of 65.

sections.label: National mental health practice framework
sections.summary: The proposal states that what is really needed is a national recovery and stabilisation-oriented mental health practice framework.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
sentences.text: My proposal: what we really need is a national recovery and stabilisation-oriented mental health practice framework.

sections.label: Mental health advocacy and blueprint
sections.summary: The speaker suggests advocacy and partnership with NGOs and VWOs, alignment with $160 million for mental health, and asks MOH when the next mental health blueprint will be up.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
sentences.text: And to value-add to the suggested model, a focus on advocacy and partnership with a variety of groups, such as NGOs and voluntary welfare organisations (VWOs), is also beneficial.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
sentences.text: This suggested framework can align with probably part of the $160 million set aside for mental health for the next five years.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
sentences.text: This model framework can also guide recovery-oriented services.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
sentences.text: Also, can I ask MOH for an update as to when the next mental health blueprint will be up?

sections.label: Alliance of step-down care institutions
sections.summary: The speaker suggests an alliance of step-down care institutions with AIC-coordinated ILTC organisations and asks how MOM initiatives link these institutions with jobseekers.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: At the last Budget, I suggested for VWOs or private organisations to run an alliance of step-down care institutions.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: By forming an association with ILTC organisations coordinated by AIC, the alliance can help bring these institutions up to speed with technology, improve their processes to become more manpower-lean, as well as develop career opportunities and advancement for their staff.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: With approximately 30,000 jobs to fill, how pervasive are the initiatives rolled out by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), such as Professional Conversion Programme (PCP), Career Support Programme and how can we link step-down care institutions with jobseekers under the Attach and Train programme which is newly announced?

sections.label: Managing healthcare budget allocation
sections.summary: The speaker asks how budget allocation can be managed given the ageing population's need for acute care spending and the Ministry's gradual budget cut.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Bearing in mind the ageing population's need for continued spending in acute care hospitals and the gradual cut in the Ministry's budget in the next two years, how can we manage the allocation of budget effectively?

sections.label: Academy for healthcare sector
sections.summary: The speaker suggests MOH develop an academy for the healthcare sector to help structure training for workers.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: With abundant training opportunities and great growth potential for the professionals, managers and executives (PMEs) in the healthcare sector, I suggest for MOH to develop an academy for the healthcare sector to help in structuring training for workers.

sections.label: Healthcare spending and support ratio
sections.summary: Government healthcare spending per capita rose from an average of $488 in 2003 to $1,962 in 2016, while the old-age support ratio is falling.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: The Government healthcare spending per capita has also been rising from an average of $488 in 2003 to $1,962 in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: The old-age support ratio, however, is steadily falling from nine is to one in 2000 to an expected two is to one in 2030.

sections.label: Healthcare worker shortage and attrition
sections.summary: MOH projects 30,000 additional healthcare workers needed by 2020, but attracting Singaporeans to caregiving jobs has been difficult and attrition has been higher than desired.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: MOH has projected that 30,000 additional healthcare workers will be needed by 2020, many of whom will be providing direct caregiving services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: So far, it has been an uphill task attracting more Singaporeans to such caregiving jobs and also the attrition rate, particularly in the public sector, has been higher than desired.

sections.label: Tobacco control public consultation
sections.summary: MOH has just completed a public consultation on a suite of potential tobacco control measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: MOH has just completed a public consultation on a suite of potential tobacco control measures.

sections.label: Third-hand smoke hazards
sections.summary: Research highlights third-hand smoke dangers, and it is asked whether MOH will implement more stringent measures against them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Recent research has highlighted the dangers of third-hand smoke.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Third-hand smoke clings to the hair, clothes and any surface in the vicinity long after smoking has stopped.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: The residual nicotine and chemicals build up on surfaces over time and resist normal cleaning, posing a potential health hazard to anyone exposed to them, especially children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Would MOH implement more stringent measures to combat the hazards of third-hand smoke?

sections.label: Healthcare and aged care staffing
sections.summary: About 9,000 additional staff are estimated to be needed in the next three years, about 50% in PMET-level roles.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the next three years, we estimate that about 9,000 additional staff will be needed for new facilities and services in the public healthcare and aged care settings.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Approximately 50% of these jobs are PMET-level roles.

sections.label: Healthcare conversion and training funding
sections.summary: MOH will invest an additional $24 million over three years to enhance healthcare conversion and training programmes for mid-career Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH will invest an additional $24 million over the next three years to enhance our healthcare conversion and training programmes to enable more mid-career Singaporeans to take up new careers in the sector.

sections.label: Nursing PCP and on-the-job training
sections.summary: MOH will increase nursing PCP training funding so employers co-fund 10%, and provide on-the-job training support for mid-career ENs and RNs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This year, MOH will further increase funding for nursing PCP training so that employers co-fund only 10% of the training cost, down from the current 20% to 50%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will also provide new on-the-job training support of $12,000 per mid-career EN and $16,000 per mid-career RN to employers.

sections.label: Nursing home capacity increase
sections.summary: MOH is on track to increase nursing home capacity to 17,000 beds by 2020, a 33% increase from 2016.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the past five years, MOH has increased aged care capacity substantially and is on track to increase our nursing home capacity to 17,000 beds by 2020, an increase of 33% from 2016.

sections.label: Day and home care services
sections.summary: MOH aims to increase day and home care services by 40% between 2016 and 2020, and provides FDW grants to some 6,900 households caring for seniors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Between 2016 and 2020, MOH aims to increase day and home care services by 40%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Today, many seniors are also cared for at home by foreign domestic workers (FDWs) and the Government provides FDW grants to some 6,900 households caring for seniors.

sections.label: On-the-job training support for employers
sections.summary: MOH will provide on-the-job training support of $10,000 to employers for each new care worker.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition, MOH will provide on-the-job training support of $10,000 to employers for each new care worker, to better facilitate mentoring, supervision and development of the new hires.

sections.label: Support for non-practising nurses
sections.summary: Non-practising nurses employed by aged care providers get refresher course fee support, full salaries during three-month training, and a $3,000 to $5,000 bonus.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Non-practising nurses employed by aged care providers will receive support for their refresher training course fees and draw full salaries now, instead of training allowances during their three-month training.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: They will also be able to enjoy a bonus of between $3,000 and $5,000 for transiting into the aged care sector.

sections.label: Community nursing teams in RHSes
sections.summary: The RHSes have started community nursing teams providing preventive and transitional care in the northern and eastern regions, serving over 3,000 clients to date.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The RHSes have started a network of community nursing teams providing preventive and transitional care in the northern and eastern regions, which have served over 3,000 clients to date.

sections.label: Community Nursing Scholarship
sections.summary: MOH plans to introduce a Community Nursing Scholarship later this year to attract GCE "O" and "A" level students into community nursing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH plans to introduce a Community Nursing Scholarship later this year to attract GCE "O" and "A" level students into nursing with specialisation in community nursing.

sections.label: Scholarship for in-service nurses
sections.summary: The scholarship will support in-service nurses joining community nursing via local and overseas programmes, targeting 20 community nursing scholars annually.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The scholarship will also support in-service nurses who are keen to join community nursing to deepen their skills via local and overseas programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are targeting 20 community nursing scholars annually.

sections.label: Nursing Education Executive Committee review
sections.summary: MOH convened a Nursing Education Executive Committee of nursing leaders, with its review to be completed by 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH has convened a Nursing Education Executive Committee (NEEC) comprising nursing leaders and will complete its review by 2018.

sections.label: Skills Framework for healthcare staff
sections.summary: A Skills Framework will be developed for nurses, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, speech therapists, pharmacy technicians and support care staff, targeted for launch in end-2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For a start, we will focus on developing the Skills Framework for nurses, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, speech therapists, pharmacy technicians and support care staff, and this is targeted for launch in end-2018.

sections.label: Foreign doctors and nurses share
sections.summary: Foreign doctors make up 16% and foreign nurses 33% of the total medical and nursing workforce respectively.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Currently, foreign doctors and nurses make up 16% and 33% of our total medical and nursing workforce respectively.

sections.label: Support for hiring FDWs
sections.summary: The Government supported households hiring FDWs to care for seniors and disabled persons with a reduced $60 monthly levy and a $120 monthly grant.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Government has also supported households which need to hire FDWs to care for seniors and disabled persons with a reduced FDW levy of $60 per month and an FDW Grant of $120 per month.

sections.label: Target of 1,000 cases yearly
sections.summary: By 2021, the target is to respond and support about 1,000 cases a year, up from the current 500.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: By 2021, we target to respond and support about 1,000 cases a year, up from the current 500.

sections.label: AIC mental health community outreach
sections.summary: AIC will partner social service agencies to support clients with stable mental health conditions, and community outreach teams will expand from 18 to 50 by 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: AIC will partner and support social service agencies so that they can support clients with stable mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will also expand our network of community outreach teams from the current 18 to 50 by 2021, to educate the public on mental health and reach out to vulnerable and at-risk individuals.

sections.label: IMH patient capacity increase
sections.summary: IMH expects to support an additional 3,000 patients over the next five years, on top of the current 8,000 patients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: IMH expects to be able to support an additional 3,000 patients over the next five years, on top of the current 8,000 patients.

sections.label: Raising minimum legal age for tobacco
sections.summary: MOH will propose legislative changes within a year to raise the minimum legal age for sale of tobacco products to minors from 18 to 21.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH will take further steps to reduce, if not eliminate, the opportunities for our young to be tempted and to take up smoking before 21.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will propose legislative changes to Parliament within a year to raise the MLA for sale of tobacco products to minors, from 18 to 21.

sections.label: Standardised tobacco packaging consultation
sections.summary: MOH will conduct a further public consultation on standardised packaging this year and review public health, intellectual property and international law considerations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have closely studied the experience of these countries and seen significant value in moving in this direction so as to reduce the appeal of tobacco products, particularly to youths, and raise the visibility and effectiveness of health warnings.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will conduct a further public consultation on standardised packaging this year to seek additional and more detailed views on possible standardised packaging measures.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will carefully review relevant considerations, including public health, intellectual property and international law perspectives, and ensure that any measures taken are consistent with our domestic law and international obligations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor international best practices in tobacco control and will adopt appropriate measures to control tobacco use.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: While the CHAS scheme helps bring some of the patients to nearby GPs, many Clementi residents are concerned whether the polyclinic will get more crowded in the years ahead, especially with new HDB developments, an ageing population, more chronic diseases and senior residents with mobility needs needing more space in the waiting room of the polyclinic as they move around.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Can MOH consider expanding the Clementi Polyclinic and other polyclinics nationwide in a similar situation?

sections.label: Subsidised care for life-limiting illness
sections.summary: MOH is to ensure every child with a life-limiting illness and their parents have adequate access to subsidised care in the community.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: No parent wants to see their child suffering or in pain.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: This is why it is all the more important that MOH ensures that every child with a life-limiting illness, every such child and their parents, have adequate access to subsidised care in the community so that on this most heartbreaking of journeys, parent and child can be supported as best as possible.

sections.label: Accessible affordable palliative care
sections.summary: The passage asks how to ensure good quality palliative care will be accessible at affordable fees.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: In addition, how do we ensure that good quality palliative care will be accessible at affordable fees?

sections.label: NurtureSG Taskforce on youth health
sections.summary: Dr Janil Puthucheary and the speaker co-led an interagency NurtureSG Taskforce last year to guide a plan to enhance health outcomes among the young.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Minister of State Dr Janil Puthucheary and I co-led an interagency NurtureSG Taskforce last year to jointly guide the development of a plan to enhance the health outcomes among our young.

sections.label: NurtureSG taskforce and health areas
sections.summary: A taskforce co-chaired by Dr Janil Puthucheary and the speaker developed a NurtureSG plan to enhance young Singaporeans' health outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Last year, Minister of State for Education Dr Janil Puthucheary and I co-chaired a taskforce to jointly develop a NurtureSG plan to enhance the health outcomes of young Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: NurtureSG focuses on the health of our children and youths in three health considerations, including physical activity and nutrition, mental well-being and sleep health.

sections.label: NurtureSG three key health areas
sections.summary: NurtureSG seeks to foster healthier habits in the young in physical activity and nutrition, mental well-being and sleep health.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: NurtureSG seeks to foster healthier habits in our young in three key areas, namely, physical activity and nutrition, mental well-being and sleep health.

sections.label: ECDA doubles preschool physical activity time
sections.summary: ECDA will double the minimum daily physical activity time for full-day preschool programmes to an hour, with 30 minutes outdoors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To complement the efforts of improving nutrition in the meals served in preschools, the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) will double the minimum daily time for physical activities for full-day preschool programmes to an hour a day, of which, 30 minutes will be conducted outdoors to cultivate young children's interests in physical activities.

sections.label: HPB good sleep habits campaign
sections.summary: HPB will launch a campaign in mid-2017 to share tips about good sleep habits.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: HPB will be launching a campaign in mid-2017 to share tips about good sleep habits.

sections.label: Diabetes and kidney failure cases
sections.summary: In 2014, two in three new kidney failure cases were due to diabetes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In 2014, two in three new kidney failure cases were due to diabetes.

sections.label: Extending enhanced NEMO programme
sections.summary: From April this year, an enhanced version of the NEMO programme is planned to be extended.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: From April this year, we plan to extend an enhanced version of the NEMO programme.

sections.label: GPs, CHAS and PCNs
sections.summary: GPs are part of the healthcare ecosystem; CHAS was introduced in 2012 and PCNs piloted in 2012, and PCNs will be scaled up this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Our GPs are, therefore, very much a part of our healthcare ecosystem in delivering care in our communities and providing better chronic disease management for our patients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We have introduced the CHAS scheme in 2012 to provide means-tested patient subsidies at participating CHAS GPs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We have also piloted the Primary Care Networks (PCNs) in 2012 which have shown promising results, in terms of the outcome of chronic diseases management.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This year, we will be scaling up our PCNs to better support GPs.

sections.label: PCN application call launch
sections.summary: MOH will launch the PCN application call on 1 April this year for two months, and interested GPs are encouraged to apply.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: MOH will be launching the PCN application call on 1 April this year for a period of two months and interested GPs are encouraged to participate in this application.

sections.label: NEHR support and concerns
sections.summary: Dr Theresa Yap and consulted public supported NEHR, but concerns were raised on record security, confidentiality and provider costs; the draft Bill will be publicly consulted this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: One of our Focus Group Discussion participants, Dr Theresa Yap, commended NEHR as she felt that it not only enabled her to make better treatment decisions but also provided patients with greater continuity of care when they visited multiple healthcare checkpoints.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Members of the public who were consulted were also supportive of NEHR as they felt that it would make healthcare less costly by preventing duplication of diagnostic tests and chances of erroneous prescription or drug interactions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: However, we are also aware of the concerns raised with regard to ensuring security of patient records, confidentiality of patient information and costs to providers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The draft Bill will be put up for public consultation this year.

sections.label: Healthcare Productivity Roadmap projects
sections.summary: Since April 2012, more than 200 ground-up projects have been supported under the Healthcare Productivity Roadmap.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Since April 2012, we have supported more than 200 ground-up projects under the Healthcare Productivity Roadmap.

sections.label: Patient information documentation time
sections.summary: Patient information is collected once, stored and pre-populated, enabling nurses to spend 10% less time on documentation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Patient information is now collected just once, then stored and pre-populated, enabling our nurses to spend 10% less time on documentation.

sections.label: Tan Tock Seng ward remodeling
sections.summary: Tan Tock Seng Hospital reduced walking distance for healthcare staff by nearly half through remodeling of their wards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Tan Tock Seng Hospital has reduced walking distance for healthcare staff by nearly half through a remodeling of their wards.

sections.label: National Steps Challenge participation
sections.summary: Minister Gan said nearly 500,000 Singaporeans of all ages have participated in the National Steps Challenge so far.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Minister Gan spoke about the National Steps Challenge.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: So far, nearly 500,000 Singaporeans of all ages have participated.

sections.label: Healthier Ingredient Development Scheme launch
sections.summary: The Healthier Ingredient Development Scheme starts 1 July this year, funding food manufacturers to develop products with healthier ingredients.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: To further encourage the use of healthier ingredients by the food industry, we will introduce the Healthier Ingredient Development Scheme (HIDS) from 1 July this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: HIDS will provide funding support for food manufacturers to innovate and develop tasty products with healthier ingredients, such as incorporating more whole grains and using healthier cooking oils.

sections.label: HCS market share and sugar levels
sections.summary: HCS product market share rose from 15% in 2012 to 18% in 2016, and median sugar in pre-packaged beverages fell from 9.5% to 6.5%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: The market share of HCS products has increased from 15% in 2012 to 18% in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: For example, the median sugar level of pre-packaged beverages has decreased from 9.5% to 6.5% over the past decade.

sections.label: Diabetes Risk Assessment and screening subsidies
sections.summary: MOH rolls out the Diabetes Risk Assessment tool from 1 September this year and enhances Screen for Life subsidies, fixing fees at $5 and $2 for CHAS cardholders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Learning from the experiences of other countries, such as the US, UK, Australia and Finland, MOH will roll out the Diabetes Risk Assessment (DRA) tool from September 1 this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: From 1 September this year, we will also enhance Government subsidies for the Screen for Life programme to encourage more Singaporeans to go for screening and post-screening consultation at CHAS clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: The fee for screening and the first post-screening consultation will be fixed at $5 for eligible Singaporeans and $2 for CHAS cardholders, both Blue and Orange.

sections.label: Palliative care beds and home places
sections.summary: Singapore has 232 palliative care beds and about 5,500 home palliative care places yearly, on track for 360 beds and 6,000 places by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: At the national level, we currently have 232 palliative care beds and about 5,500 home palliative care places per year and we are on track to meet the target of 360 palliative care beds and 6,000 home palliative care places per year by 2020.

sections.label: Palliative care subsidies and ElderShield review
sections.summary: From 1 August 2017 MOH extends subsidies to paediatrics home palliative care, following earlier MediSave and hospice measures, and the ElderShield Review Committee is examining benefits and premiums.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: From 1 August 2017, MOH will extend subsidies to paediatrics home palliative care to provide the families of these children with more financial support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: This follows earlier measures by MOH, such as removal of the MediSave withdrawal limit in 2015 for patients on home palliative care for cancer and end-stage organ failure.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: We also introduced subsidies and MediSave coverage for day hospice care in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: We have formed the ElderShield Review Committee chaired by Mr Chaly Mah in October last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In doing its review, the Committee is looking at ways to enhance the benefits and payout period, while balancing the need to keep premiums affordable for all Singaporeans.

sections.label: Cancer screening for low-income women
sections.summary: MOH promotes cancer screening, offering free mammograms with Breast Cancer Foundation since 2012 to about 25,000 low-income women, and workplace health grants to 108 companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: One key focus is on promoting screening, such as cancer screening and breast cancer screening, and we have worked with the Breast Cancer Foundation since 2012, particularly for low-income women.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since 2012, we have been offering mammograms for women from low-income families at no cost, together with Breast Cancer Foundation, and we have reached out to about 25,000 women.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition, we have promoted healthy lifestyle and habits to women at the workplace through our women's workplace health grant to about 108 companies.

sections.label: Gestational diabetes screening in hospitals
sections.summary: Gestational diabetes screening is now available in all public hospitals for pregnant women.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, now, gestational diabetes screening is available in all public hospitals for pregnant women.

sections.label: No new Hougang polyclinic planned
sections.summary: There are no plans for a new polyclinic in Hougang, though MOH reviews polyclinic utilisation across Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At this moment, we do not have any plans for a new polyclinic in Hougang but I would like to reassure the Member that MOH does look at the utilisation of polyclinics all around Singapore.

sections.label: Building strong local medical workforce
sections.summary: Building a strong local workforce is the top priority, with medical intake rising to 500 eventually with the new medical school.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, the top priority is to build a strong local workforce.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And, as I have said earlier, first of all, our medical intake has been increasing over the years and, with the addition of the new medical school, our intake will increase to 500 eventually.

sections.label: Medical intake increase and foreign workforce
sections.summary: The target is a 30% intake increase this year, with foreign doctors at about 16% and nursing at 33%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Our target this year is to increase it by another 30%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: It decreased for a while but with intensive efforts to reach out to students as well as even mid-career professionals through our PCP programmes, the intake for fresh students has turned around and it is increasing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, currently, as I have noted earlier also, the foreign workforce for doctors is about 16% and for nursing it is 33%.

sections.label: Kampung Admiralty integrated care hub
sections.summary: MOH works with MND and HDB on new housing forms and care services, such as the Kampung Admiralty Integrated Hub's Active Ageing Hub.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In line with her idea, we are already working with MND and HDB to look at new housing forms as well as care services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For instance, in the Kampung Admiralty Integrated Hub, there will be an active ageing hub that will provide senior care as well as active ageing programmes and homecare and home monitoring from the Active Ageing Hub for residents living in the studio apartments in that integrated hub.

sections.label: Nursing home licensing checks
sections.summary: Pre-licensing and compliance checks, plus possible independent audits, are done, and licence periods and services are posted online.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have explained earlier, we will do pre-licensing checks and then compliance checks after we have licensed them and, if necessary, also audits by independent auditors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we do is put up the licence period of all the nursing homes on our website, including the kind of services they provide.

sections.label: Committee on nursing curricula
sections.summary: A committee is being formed to look into nurses' training curricula and curricula on their roles.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Indeed, we are forming a committee to look into the curricular of our nurses in terms of training as well as curricular on the roles they play.

sections.label: Higher order jobs for ENs
sections.summary: For ENs, higher order, higher value-added jobs and deeper roles will be looked at.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For the nurses, as I have said in the speech, for ENs, we will look at allowing them to do higher order jobs, higher value-added jobs, take on deeper roles.

sections.label: Overweight students and NurtureSG
sections.summary: Overweight and severely overweight students rose from 10% to 12% in 2016, and NurtureSG will provide more support.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: While the obesity rate amongst our children is not alarming compared to the western countries, the proportion of overweight and severely overweight students in our mainstream schools has crept up from 10% to 12% in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Under NurtureSG, a new programme for students will be implemented to provide more support to them.
